title: WorkflowDefinition
description: Represents a type of object ("entity") in the workflow system

name.description: Short internal name of the entity type

title.description: Localized title of the entity type

titlePlural.description: Localized plural of the entity type title

index.description: Integer indicating the tab order in the instance page

isAlwaysVisible.description: Always show this entity type to the user, even if the user has no rights

inheritsFrom.description: Name of the entity type this type inherits from

steps.description: List of step names for this entity type

StringPropertyDefinition.title: StringPropertyDefinition
StringPropertyDefinition.description: Text value with optional input layout and length validation.

visibility.description: Set if this propertyDefinition is hidden from users without extra permissions

shortText.description: Localized short propertyDefinition text to shown in results

type.description:
Data type of the propertyDefinition. Can be a primitive type String, Int, Double, DateTime, Date, User, Currency, File, Check
            or a reference to a value set or another entity type. Use [Type] to indicate an array and Type! to indicate
            a required value.

default.description: Expression used to initialize this property when an instance is created without a value.

description.description: Localized extended description text for the propertyDefinition.

condition.description: Condition that determines if the propertyDefinition should be shown

validation.description: Condition that determines if the value is valid

onSave.description: Effect that is run whenever a value is changed for this property

hideInResults.description: Determines if the propertyDefinition should be hidden in the results table

sources.description: If set, this question is included in a form only when editing a matching property

linkedTo.description: The name of another property this property is linked to.

multiline.description: Set if the field should be a multiline text field

allowAttachments.description: Set if the text field should allow attachments

oneOf.description: Renders the string field as a specific input (e.g. email or phone) with matching validation

not.description: If true, this condition is inverted

event.description: Check if an event has occurred

oneOf.description: Check if a date has passed

deadline.description: Check if a deadline has not yet passed. Use a step's deadline setting for soft/hard submission deadlines.

message.description: Message that is shown then the condition is not, for use in form validation

Value.title: Value
Value.description:
Represents a value comparison. Use this to compare two properties, or to compare a property to a fixed literal value
            (prefix a string value with an equals sign to indicate a literal value)

equal.description: Value the property should be equal to. If this is a literal string, it must be prefixed with an equals sign

lessThan.description: Value the property should be less than

lessThanOrEqual.description: Value the property should be less than or equal to

greaterThan.description: Value the property should be greater than

greaterThanOrEqual.description: Value the property should be greater than or equal to

in.description: Array the property should be in

isEmpty.description: If set, check whether the property is empty

id.description: Id of the event to check for

name.description: Optional effect name, used to refer to outputs of this effect

condition.description: Condition that determines if this trigger is active

oneOf.description: Prepare login access and send one personalized email per recipient
Do an http call to an external service
Set a property on the current instance
Redirect the user to an url
Create external login access for the assigned user or users of a workflow role

to.description: Recipients: each entry is a property lookup (User or [User]), a literal email address, or a template.

type.description: Toast type to show in the frontend

message.description: Toast message to show in the frontend

url.description: Template for the url to call

value.description: Expression that determines the value of the property

role.description: Name of the workflow role/property that holds the target user or users

type.description: Determines what kind of results are shown for this field

source.description: For Type = Source, this determines which source property to use
